class.name: HTMLButtonElement
class.brief_description: A handle to an HTML button element.
class.description: Returned by queries and [method HTMLLayout.create_element] for [code]<button>[/code]. [HTMLLabel] can activate enabled buttons with [code]type="button"[/code].

members.member: Whether the [code]disabled[/code] attribute is present. Setting this to [code]false[/code] removes the attribute.
The button's source [code]type[/code] attribute. An absent attribute returns an empty string.
